params.body:
The featured report sat as a framed picture in a black block: a white border around the cover on the left, and plain black on the right. It now fills the band.

- **Left:** the cover runs edge to edge, with no border, at its own height, so the title and the wordmark on the cover are never cut off.
- **Right:** the same cover again, enlarged and heavily blurred, under a dark veil. The colours of the report carry into the text side, and the text stays readable.
- **One component,** `x-report-feature`, now used by both the homepage and `/reports`. The two copies had already drifted apart: only `/reports` showed the note for a report without a preview. Both pages now show it.

On the homepage the band runs the full width of the screen. The heading "The Reports" and the list of upcoming reports keep their usual margins.

Tests: 332 passing. Checked locally with the real cover of "Going to School in Phone-Free Europe", at 1440 px and at 400 px.
params.title: The featured report fills its band
